description: This file contains shell script utilities for configuring and managing Broadcom Ethernet switch features, including VLAN and QoS settings, port configurations, and security defenses such as DOS attack prevention.

methods.name: get_ethernet_port
methods.description: Translates a port number into a hardware-specific address for the Ethernet switch.

methods.name: enable_vlan_mode_on_ethernet_switch
methods.description: Enables VLAN mode on the Ethernet switch.

methods.name: disable_vlan_mode_on_ethernet_switch
methods.description: Disables VLAN mode on the Ethernet switch.

methods.name: enable_port_qos_on_ethernet_switch
methods.description: Enables Quality of Service (QoS) on the switch, setting specific register values.

methods.name: disable_port_qos_on_ethernet_switch
methods.description: Disables QoS on the switch, restoring default settings.

methods.name: set_vlan_on_ethernet_port
methods.description: Assigns a VLAN ID to a specific Ethernet port.

methods.name: set_prio_on_ethernet_port
methods.description: Sets priority bits on a specific Ethernet port.

methods.name: vendor_block_dos_land_attack
methods.description: Enables protections against DOS land attacks by configuring switch registers.
